title: Reasoning and Precedent
grammar: Recap: Cause with miatt and következtében
goal: I can give the cause of a decision with *miatt* or *következtében*.
I can link two sentences with *emiatt* and *ezért*.
I can use the main words of judicial reasoning: *indokolás*, *precedens*, *különvélemény*.
